narrative.overview: This DESIGN.md documents "El Plano," the blueprint/technical-drafting world built for the Home page's own section components only (HeroSection, ServicesSection, ProcessSection, WhyUsSection, ProjectsSection, TeamSection, CTASection, and the shared primitives in src/components/plano/). The shared site chrome (Header, Footer, LoadingScreen) and every other page (Services, Projects, Contact, Blog, etc.) still run on the prior BApps purple/yellow system (Delta Gothic One + Commissioner) — that system remains authoritative everywhere outside Home until it gets its own redesign pass. El Plano reads Home as a set of drawing sheets rather than marketing cards: a hero drawn like a cyanotype cover sheet, a services "schedule" instead of icon cards, a process phasing strip with dimension brackets, an inspection checklist standing in for a benefits grid, and project cards carrying their own title block. It refuses the gradient-hero-and-blob agency default on purpose. Two sheet materials carry the built page: the deep cyanotype-blue ground (hero and the closing CTA) and warm vellum paper (WhyUs). The middle content sections (Services, Process, Projects, Team) actually run on the site's existing dark neutral tokens, not the cyanotype blue — a deliberate divergence from the original direction contract's language, documented here as shipped.
keyCharacteristics: Hand-drafted display lettering (Architects Daughter) paired with a plain, legible body face (Archivo) and a mono register (JetBrains Mono) reserved for labels, codes, and measurements.
Flat at rest — no box-shadows anywhere in the built system; depth comes from ruled lines, ink-grain texture, and layered stroke rings.
Square-cornered by default; the one exception is anything 'certified' — stamps, seals, registration marks — which is always fully round.
A single reused signature motion (the self-drawing ink line) instead of scattered fade/slide entrances.

rules.name: The Rare Stamp Rule
rules.body: Stamp Red appears only on primary CTAs, the hero's highlighted word, and status/seal marks — never as a background fill or body text color.

rules.name: The One Voice, Three Registers Rule
rules.body: Architects Daughter is reserved for headlines only; Archivo carries every sentence of body copy; JetBrains Mono is the exclusive register for labels, marks, codes, and annotations.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, anywhere. Depth is a ruled line, a stroke ring, or ink-grain texture — never a shadow.

dos: Do reserve Architects Daughter for headlines only; Archivo for body; JetBrains Mono for labels/marks/measurements — never mix registers.
Do use the DrawLine self-drawing stroke for underlines, leader-lines, and progress indicators instead of a generic fade/slide entrance.
Do keep Stamp Red rare — CTAs and seals only, never a background or body-text color.
Do keep drafted elements square-cornered and reserve rounded-full for anything meant to read as certified/sealed (stamps, seals, registration marks, avatars).
donts: Don't carry --plano-* tokens, Architects Daughter, or the stamp/mark-tag components into Header, Footer, LoadingScreen, or any non-Home page without a deliberate follow-on redesign of that surface — they still run on the BApps purple/yellow system and mixing the two palettes on one surface is not a supported state.
Don't add a box-shadow anywhere in El Plano; depth is ruled lines, ink-grain, and stroke rings only.

Don't use a colored border-left/border-right above 1px on cards, list items, callouts, or alerts — a craft-floor default this system avoids; dividers and nesting read through plain border (1px, neutral) instead.
